subject: Punchout / VOR / W-9 / VAT routing for co-sell invoice flow with ACME
messages:
From: Sophia Chang <sophia.chang@aws-partner.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: AWS punchout + co-sell routing: tax & invoice responsibilities for ACME purchase

Hi Vivek / Vanessa —

ACME (the buyer) is moving forward with a co-sell purchase via AWS Marketplace and they asked us to confirm the invoice path and tax evidence requirements before we enable punchout. Two specific asks from their finance team:

1) Who will be the Vendor of Record (VOR) on the invoice once punchout is configured? Can Redwood be VOR or will AWS be issuing the invoice? ACME needs a VOR invoice to claim tax credits.

2) For US tax compliance they request an up-to-date W-9 for the vendor invoicing them. If Redwood will be VOR, can you provide a W-9 that we can surface to ACME (DocuSign link preferred)?

3) For VAT/reverse-charge handling (ACME has an EU entity that may be in scope for some future deals), what evidence do you need from the buyer to apply reverse charge or zero-rate VAT?

I've attached the AWS punchout spec that the procurement team uses (aws_marketplace_punchout_spec.pdf). Can you confirm Redwood's preferred configuration and any sample invoice templates/line-item mappings you require for marketplace co-sell flows?

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call with procurement if helpful.

Best,
Sophia
Partnerships, AWS Marketplace
Attachment: aws_marketplace_punchout_spec.pdf
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Sophia Chang <sophia.chang@aws-partner.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS punchout + co-sell routing: tax & invoice responsibilities for ACME purchase

Sophia —

Thanks for the clear summary. Short answers up front: Redwood can be configured as Vendor of Record (VOR) for the ACME purchase; we can provide a signed W-9 and a VOR-formatted invoice that lists tax breakdowns per line item. Alternatively, if the marketplace operator issues the invoice (AWS VOR), we provide the necessary tax evidence to them but the invoice will come from AWS and ACME has told us they prefer vendor-issued invoices for tax credits, so VOR = Redwood is preferred by the buyer.

Notes / nuances:
- W-9: we can upload a W-9 to the AWS partner portal and provide a DocuSign copy to ACME. We usually include our EIN and remittance address on the W-9 we provide.
- VAT / reverse charge: for EU buyers we need the buyer's VAT registration number + a VAT exemption certificate (or EU VAT ID verification) to zero-rate. For proof-of-place-of-supply we typically need the billing entity country + VAT ID on the purchase order/invoice.
- Punchout: to ensure Redwood is VOR you need the punchout catalog + procurement config to point the order to our vendor_id and ensure the PO number is captured in the punchout payload. We prefer line-item SKU mapping to our internal product codes so our billing system can reconcile invoice lines automatically.

I'm attaching quick internal notes on how we typically configure punchout and the minimum fields we require (redwood_punchout_notes.docx).

Can Marissa (cc) comment on the invoice template we should share and the W-9 process? Also looping Vanessa on routing + marketplace contract terms that might affect tax treatment.

Regards,
Vivek
Head of Cloud Partnerships | Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_punchout_notes.docx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sophia Chang <sophia.chang@aws-partner.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: AWS punchout + co-sell routing: tax & invoice responsibilities for ACME purchase

Thanks Vivek / Sophia — quick procurement notes from our side:

- Invoice & PO requirements: ACME needs the PO# on the invoice and the buyer legal name + remit-to address exactly as on their PO. If the PO originates from punchout we ask that the payload include billing_entity_name and billing_vat_id fields.
- W-9 handling: provide DocuSign copy to ACME and upload a PDF to the partner portal. We should confirm whether ACME accepts an uploaded W-9 in their vendor portal or needs DocuSign directly.
- Line items: include SKU, short description, quantity, unit price, tax amount, and tax code per line. I'm attaching a CSV example with our recommended column mapping (line_item_mapping_example.csv). This minimizes manual rework for our finance team and speeds reconciliation.
- Withholding / backup withholding: if ACME ever requests withholding (rare for domestic SaaS), we'll need a contract addendum — discuss with legal if that becomes necessary.

I'll draft a sample invoice template and a short checklist we can give to ACME procurement. Who should own the DocuSign W-9 link we send? I propose we (Redwood finance) send DocuSign and copy AWS so the marketplace record is consistent.

Marissa
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachment: line_item_mapping_example.csv
From: ACME Finance <finance@acme-corp.com>
To: Sophia Chang <sophia.chang@aws-partner.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Punchout / VOR / W-9 / VAT routing for co-sell invoice flow with ACME

Hi Sophia / Vivek / Marissa —

Thanks for the quick responses. ACME finance confirms:
- We require Redwood to be the Vendor of Record. We cannot take the AWS-issued invoice for our tax-credit reconciliation.
- Please provide a signed W-9 with remittance address. DocuSign link is preferred.
- PO attached (PO-889233.pdf) — please include this PO# on the final invoice.

Also note we need the invoice to include our VAT ID and a clear breakdown of taxes per line so we can apply the correct internal accounting treatment. We are US-headquartered for this purchase but will expect similar evidence for future EU purchases.

Regards,
Jamie Bryant
Director of Finance, ACME Corp
Attachment: PO-889233.pdf
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Bryant <finance@acme-corp.com>, Sophia Chang <sophia.chang@aws-partner.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Punchout / VOR / W-9 / VAT routing for co-sell invoice flow with ACME 

Jamie / Sophia —

Great — thanks for confirming. Proposed next steps and owners:

1) W-9: Redwood finance (Marissa) will send a DocuSign W-9 to ACME and upload a copy to the AWS partner portal. (Owner: Marissa)
2) Punchout & VOR: Sophia / AWS to configure punchout payload so that Vendor ID points to Redwood and PO# is preserved in the order XML. We will validate a test order once configured. (Owner: Sophia)
3) Invoice template & line items: Marissa will prepare a VOR invoice template (including SKU mapping + per-line tax columns) and share with ACME for sign-off. (Owner: Marissa)
4) Timeline: aim to complete W-9 and invoice template within 3 business days, then run a test purchase the following day.

I'll coordinate the test and confirm once the DocuSign W-9 is sent. If anything changes on ACME's side for EU VAT evidence we'll handle that as a follow-up (buyer VAT ID + certificate required for reverse charge).

Thanks all —
Vivek
